decisions.reason: Linking portfolio tiles to the gallery is a separate clause and behavior; changing the hero image subject does not alter the tile-link requirement.
The hero image subject does not change the destinations or behavior of homepage page-link buttons.
Replacing the homepage hero image with a house photo does not change gallery hover-animation behavior.
The hero image subject is unrelated to package counts, square-footage ranges, or displayed prices.

The source separately requests replacement of identified stock photos, which already has a same-message candidate Event, but it does not state that the new house hero photo must be client-supplied or otherwise change this requirement's sourcing rules.
Selecting a house as the homepage hero subject is consistent with, but does not modify, the existing site-wide image-focused presentation rule.
The homepage hero image is distinct from the portfolio photographs used as gallery content.
The hero image subject does not affect mobile pricing-table layout or scrolling.
Changing the homepage hero image does not alter gallery category tabs or the optional other-photography area.
The house hero photo does not change the display or selection of individual service pricing.
The homepage hero image subject has no effect on the one-time pricing model or pricing-tab visibility.
Replacing the homepage hero image does not change the gallery's interactive scrolling behavior.
